summary: OpenAI launched an Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex that lets IT admins query workspace analytics and execute permission-scoped admin actions (member/group management, usage limits, access approvals) from within a chat conversation.

practices.reason: The plugin exposes Admin Console read/write actions as permission-aware tools that map natural-language admin requests to structured actions, a tool-use pattern a team could adapt for their own internal ops agents, though the gain is only illustrated via OpenAI's own internal Slack agent example.
practices.quote: It makes Admin Console capabilities available to ChatGPT Work and Codex as permission-aware tools, while honoring workspace policies and approval requirements.

practices.reason: Enterprises using ChatGPT Work/Codex would need to enable and install this new plugin surface and configure routing to Slack/Teams, but this is optional new functionality rather than a forced migration or deprecation.
practices.quote: First, enable the plugin in ChatGPT workspace settings, then install it from the Plugins directory in ChatGPT Work on the web or desktop app.
